dataset.name: TRACE controlled fixture v1
dataset.description: Fictional HTTP/1.1 traffic built by examples/generate_groundtruth_fixture.py. Names and usernames are invented; every span was recorded when the text was constructed. Contains hard negatives (companies, places, products, identifier look-alikes, given-name look-alikes).

provenance.notes: Scenario table fixed before any model was run on it. All fields of every message are listed.
